decisions.decision: Autonomous execution mode for Phase 38.1 (no discuss/plan/code-review subagents)
decisions.rationale: Root causes were already measured with exact file:line references from the UX validation pass. Writing CONTEXT.md + PLAN.md inline was faster and equally rigorous. Code-review skip justified because edits were surgical (nbsp unbinds, span splits, SVG rx→clipPath, body class swaps) with no logic/branching changes.

decisions.decision: html { overflow-x: clip } safety net in theme.css @layer base
decisions.rationale: Global belt-and-suspenders against decorative absolute elements (mesh-bg__blob, hero badges, blur effects) leaking document scrollWidth. `clip` chosen over `hidden` because it doesn't create a BFC and doesn't break position:sticky descendants.

decisions.decision: Checkup H1 split into 3 gradient+body spans at hospital-name boundaries
decisions.rationale: `bg-clip-text` on a span containing the full 'Samsung Medical Center и Severance Hospital' phrase became an unbreakable token at display font sizes. Splitting into two gradient spans + a body-color 'и' connector lets each hospital name wrap independently.

decisions.decision: nbsp cleanup scope: em-dash bindings removed sitewide, subject+verb and orphan-prevention bindings kept
decisions.rationale: Em-dash in Russian typography is standalone punctuation that allows line breaks on either side. The feedback_nbsp-subject-verb and feedback_nbsp-orphan-prevention memory rules still apply; only the over-application was wrong.

decisions.decision: SVG flag per-corner rounding via <clipPath> wrapper, not per-rect rx
decisions.rationale: SVG `rx` takes a single length, not CSS shorthand. `rx='0 0 3 3'` was silently ignored (producing square corners). clipPath-based rounding on the parent group is the correct primitive.

After ./tailwindcss rebuild, Playwright's in-session browser caches the stylesheet link and won't pick up changes on subsequent navigations. Workaround: force reload via `link.href = 'css/styles.css?t=' + Date.now()` in browser_evaluate. This is a dev-loop concern, not a production issue.
